componentIndexSummary.keyInsight: Actions feel crisp and flat, with color carrying emphasis instead of elevation.
Cards are low-noise containers that rely on border and tonal contrast more than depth.
Tables should stay airy despite dense information, using muted text and clear row separators.
Charts bring the strongest brand color energy and should contrast against otherwise quiet surfaces.
Navigation stays restrained, letting the active state and focused ring do the work.
The dedicated sidebar palette makes navigation feel like a branded workspace shell, not a generic list.
